status: Planning proposal only: no pose build, pose-lock approval, balance sign-off or runtime integration

contracts.facing: right in authored combat frames; mirror entire body, anchors and FX together for left; never mirror a weapon alone
contracts.statusBoundary: 34 owner-approved concepts do not approve production pose packs; signatures and expanded equipment are proposals. Only Wren/Tobin/Pip live. No subclass/Hallowed art counted because no complete revised visual contracts are approved.
contracts.poseProduction: Future source-v1 master/identity/proportions/palette/props/poses must exist before building. Choose accepted parent and edit inside a mask; gate/register/verify/audit remain mandatory. Never run approve. This manifest creates none of those artifacts.
contracts.existingKit: Read art/pose-lock-tests/pip/source-v1 identity, proportions, palette, manifest, props listing and poses; it is an isolated real-art test with a pending-review free-hand pose, not a production source kit. Other heroes have concepts/reference packs, no production source-v1 kits found. Proposed pools therefore claim no accepted parents or reusable approved PNG counts.
contracts.geometry: Local anchor is invariant. Grounded boots terminate on row 131; centre root anchor remains (96,132) while legs articulate. Per-frame gear sockets move with the wrist/waist. Jumps are omitted because no move requires them; no compulsory walking for Pip or any caster.
contracts.dash: Contact actions use visual translation only, not gameplay range/Speed/evasion. All normal dash timelines explicitly start and finish rootX=0 and rootY=0. Shared Lunge keeps only its printed Speed benefit. Root travel is one presentation envelope per action, including multihits.
contracts.interruption: Latch current world root and current hand/weapon transforms before cancelling. Blend to hurt/guard at that location through the listed interruption poses, then step back by a continuous return path only if alive and combat still needs origin. Death kneels/falls at the latched location and never snaps to origin. FX consumption cannot be replayed on cancellation.
contracts.timing: ms values are presentation targets, not balance or input-window tuning. Charged hold is bounded 80–700ms at the charge key; timed input selects grade once then earned release proceeds. Ready endpoints may remain held. Miss changes FX intensity/printed outcome, not anatomy or invented gameplay. No automatic input.
contracts.layers: All detached arrows, bats, glass-light, sparks, chips and tools are future artist-authored matching pack assets. Body sprites exclude wide FX. Hand/weapon contact, focus release, world target impact and self-state sockets are distinct.
contracts.starsCompatibility: The 72 revised Star proposals reuse the authored chosen-action body, core contact FX and pooled finite status/state layers; they add no autonomous attack, extra foe or separate activation pose. Stored/status/ward arrivals use an FX event only under their exact existing source budget. No new 72-sheet workload is counted. A Star needing a genuinely distinct visual gets a later named artist brief and explicit additional frame estimate rather than silently entering this budget. Current live 43 Stars remain distinct from those proposals.
contracts.budget: Every selected action has one direct/grade/crit/proc budget. Repeated body/contact FX keys do not create resource income or strikes. Passives add zero activation actions; optional overlays follow only their exact eligibility. No thrown equipment, extra foes, summons, new status or new resistance type.
contracts.counting: Reusable physical arrow flight modules and finite status sheets each count their distinct frames once per hero; per-card layers reference those exact IDs. bodyPoses counts distinct proposed pose IDs per hero, including equipment variants; timelineFrames counts every body key occurrence across the named sequences (ready reuse and mode variants included); fxFrames counts distinct FX frame IDs, not displayed repeats. Counts are art workload estimates, not pre-existing PNGs. Frame holds add duration, never pose count.
contracts.reducedMotion: retain anticipation/release/contact/recovery keys; collapse visual dash into three continuous short root keys 0→contactOffset→0 with no flashes or shake, or keep contact on origin if the stage cannot move. Preserve event order and input timing; static finite state glyphs replace pulsing loops.

heroes.name: Wren Hollowmere

profile.identity: Eyes closed in combat; violet bat hood and ornate bow. Listen, mark and decide when precision is worth consuming the setup.
profile.tradeoff: Holding a Mark supports resource income; spending it changes the payoff. Wounds offer a separate route.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

heroes.gatheringContract: All four actions run at every eligible live node without any tool. Crafted Pickaxe/Woodaxe/Sickle/Hunting Spear improves speed only. Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. Combat axe/spear is not silently a gathering tool.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

profile.identity: Keep Maren's liked face and bone/charcoal/bronze. Short intact mantle with few broad memorial strips, minimal shredding.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

heroes.gatheringContract: All four actions run at every eligible live node without any tool. Crafted Pickaxe/Woodaxe/Sickle/Hunting Spear improves speed only. Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. Combat axe/spear is not silently a gathering tool.

gatheringMappings.contact: fourth of six tool work keys or third of four hand keys; mining/wood chips and forage/hunt collection cue are separate artist pack FX; no bonus material event from visual repeats

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

cardMappings.name: An Oath Kept Doing

cardMappings.name: Upright

cardMappings.name: Sworn Steel
cardMappings.sourceEffect: Attack may declare one Oath for two subsequent H without extra cost. A later Attack may spend 2 Resolve and consume Oath to ignore half armour, or freely cancel Oath for Guard through the next enemy move. These modes replace one another; declaration never pays off on the same action. Uses the existing Oath token, but a passive declaration supplies only its named payout, not Declare the Oath's signature charge; a signature declaration replaces it.
cardMappings.reuse: eligible chosen Attack or wholly manual defence already authored; no passive button, counter, free strike or automatic defence

cardMappings.name: Heavy Strike
cardMappings.sourceEffect: 1.2U physical held-weapon hit. Optionally consume one source-labelled authored Opening for +0.2U aggregate direct power, replacing that Opening’s signature/held-charge payout; never both. With no Opening, useful baseline. One pooled ring/grade, default +0.15U Perfect within the common optional modifier ceiling; no additional status stack or per-packet refund.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Brynja Berg

profile.identity: Broad visibly powerful adult woman, practical heavy plate and square weather cloak. Hip lantern; old brazier retained in her history. Blunt hospitality: Come inside. I'll hold this.
profile.tradeoff: Keep the shield planted for protection or surrender the position and its Guard to release a heavier sword strike.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.

heroes.name: Nerys Fleet

profile.identity: Nerys once carried medicine through a village whose doors opened only to strangers. She learned to leave before gratitude became a trap. Now she returns for the people she left behind.
profile.tradeoff: A courier archer who chooses what to do with earned evasive momentum. Slip is preparation for the next choice, not automatic evasion.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Design signed off; use this exact concept in the hero profile.

heroes.motionSignature: quick courier shoulder recoil with planted feet; medicine motifs remain light rather than extra equipment

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange

socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only

socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.gatheringContract: All four actions run at every eligible live node without any tool. Crafted Pickaxe/Woodaxe/Sickle/Hunting Spear improves speed only. Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. Combat axe/spear is not silently a gathering tool.

heroes.name: Mab Vale

profile.identity: Mab repaired mourning clothes until the dead began leaving instructions in their hems. She does not raise them. She finishes the promises they cannot.
profile.tradeoff: One woven Curse matures after a real defended-or-landed enemy attack finishes. Cut it for pressure, unravel it for safety, or invest in its natural release.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Owner explicitly signed off all selected playable concepts without correction notes.

heroes.motionSignature: seamstress precision of the free fingers; hem folds follow the same torso twist as the staff

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange
socketDefinitions.supportGrip: second actual wrist for two-handed gear, otherwise original offhand grip/strap
socketDefinitions.focusRelease: weapon focus head for spells; remains rigid to held weapon
socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only
socketDefinitions.lantern: original concept belt/hip attachment, pendulum follows waist
socketDefinitions.tomeFolio: original supported offhand book or secured belt support, never floats
socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Peregrine Clocks

profile.identity: Peregrine repaired the village clock until it began striking for people who had not yet died. He dismantled it, kept one spring, and went to find who had wound it.
profile.tradeoff: Move one real cooldown turn between two cooling actives, then decide whether a receipt is worth collecting now. A clockmaker manipulates availability, never grants a free turn.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Design signed off; use this exact concept in the hero profile.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

If no legal pair exists, choose before payment a next-Attack +0.2U direct-power token lasting two H instead; no Receipt.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

heroes.gatheringContract: All four actions run at every eligible live node without any tool. Crafted Pickaxe/Woodaxe/Sickle/Hunting Spear improves speed only. Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. Combat axe/spear is not silently a gathering tool.

heroes.name: Tamsin Rook

profile.identity: Tamsin learned sword forms from the tolling of a cracked watch bell. She still counts the missing note, waiting for the day she can bring its maker home.
profile.tradeoff: A bellsword with a steady rhythm and an optional timing flourish: Perfect creates Accent, but ordinary Attack also supplies preparation at an action cost.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Design signed off; use this exact concept in the hero profile.

heroes.motionSignature: counted sword rhythm; shield arm supplies the missing-note pause before earned release

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange
socketDefinitions.supportGrip: second actual wrist for two-handed gear, otherwise original offhand grip/strap
socketDefinitions.focusRelease: weapon focus head for spells; remains rigid to held weapon
socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only
socketDefinitions.lantern: original concept belt/hip attachment, pendulum follows waist
socketDefinitions.tomeFolio: original supported offhand book or secured belt support, never floats
socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Sable Quill

profile.identity: Sable was a plague-house clerk who remembered every name the town tried to erase. Her cures have become sharper since the town stopped asking politely.
profile.tradeoff: A diagnostic mage who turns an actual cleanse into a choice between remedy pressure and prevention. A clean fight still has a deliberate, smaller preparation route.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Owner explicitly signed off all selected playable concepts without correction notes.

heroes.motionSignature: clinical writing hand; remedy page and coat move from the same shoulder, with no added bottle

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange
socketDefinitions.supportGrip: second actual wrist for two-handed gear, otherwise original offhand grip/strap
socketDefinitions.focusRelease: weapon focus head for spells; remains rigid to held weapon
socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only
socketDefinitions.lantern: original concept belt/hip attachment, pendulum follows waist
socketDefinitions.tomeFolio: original supported offhand book or secured belt support, never floats
socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. heroes.name: Ione Hart

profile.identity: Ione restored stained windows in a chapel with no congregation. The colours now remember the sunlight more faithfully than the sky does.
profile.tradeoff: A prism mage with a one-colour reserve. Repeating the colour means shelter; mixing sacrifices the reserve for pressure. She is not a second Frostfire stack mage.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Latest fifth-pass concept explicitly signed off.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Adela Wych

profile.identity: Adela settles the debts of people buried without their names. She will not bring a soul back; she will make the living acknowledge what they owe.
profile.tradeoff: A pale advocate whose fixed authored Debt can be collected, forgiven or used to close an account. Nothing copies arbitrary damage or runs a second crit calculation.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

heroes.name: Ysabet Fen

profile.identity: Ysabet charts the roads by listening to ice crack under distant feet. She hunts the thing that has begun walking across lakes without leaving a sound.
profile.tradeoff: A patient winter archer who decides between preserving Chill for reliable shots and spending it to attempt control. Ordinary shots work even when a boss cannot be frozen.

Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. heroes.name: Eamon Grey

profile.identity: Eamon challenged a toll collector and won the bridge. He has spent the years since learning that winning a crossing is easier than keeping it open.
profile.tradeoff: A road duellist with High and Low lines. Alternate to press through armour, repeat to settle behind Guard, or clear the line for a different kind of answer.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Owner explicitly signed off all selected playable concepts without correction notes.

heroes.motionSignature: practical crossing guard; high/low sword planes keep shield close and coat clear of the edge

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange
socketDefinitions.supportGrip: second actual wrist for two-handed gear, otherwise original offhand grip/strap
socketDefinitions.focusRelease: weapon focus head for spells; remains rigid to held weapon
socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only
socketDefinitions.lantern: original concept belt/hip attachment, pendulum follows waist
socketDefinitions.tomeFolio: original supported offhand book or secured belt support, never floats
socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Celandine Orr

profile.identity: Celandine studied wounds by lamplight after the battle surgeons left. She now seeks the source of the dark that keeps opening old scars.
profile.tradeoff: A holy surgeon who leaves a single Incision for precision, closes it for recovery, or chooses to reopen it. Healing spends the offensive setup and a hero opportunity.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.name: Flint Mercer

profile.identity: Flint maintained the road’s lightning rods. When the lamps went dark, he discovered the storm was still answering somewhere beneath the ground.
profile.tradeoff: A stormwright who budgets the same small reserve between immediate lightning, a fully committed ground strike and shelter. Charge damage contributes to the actual boss-break threshold.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Design signed off; use this exact concept in the hero profile.

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

fxSequences.branches: No-token baseline uses action keys only. Retain mode leaves existing glyph intact. Spend/cancel mode contracts the exact selected source before contact. Recovery-only branches fold toward hero. Control attempt uses one burst; rejection fizzles with no success glyph. These modes are visual choices, never additional actions.
fxSequences.releaseContact: body earned release begins projectile flight; projectile arrival (impact key 1) resolves printed contact exactly once. Held melee resolves at body contact. Pure preparation applies only at its application key. Timed paths grade once before release; untimed paths bypass input and pass charge keys continuously without a ring hold.
fxSequences.hold: timed charge peak synchronizes to body hold 80–700ms; untimed charge keys pass once without ring/input delay. Flight keys loop until arrival only. Finite state middle frame holds only to exact source expiry. Repeats do not increase distinct frame count.

heroes.name: Merrick Low

profile.identity: Merrick stopped speaking after his brother’s voice came back from the forest without him. He answers with chalk marks, and never wastes a second arrow on the same warning.
profile.tradeoff: A quiet hunter who builds a three-step shot cadence with ordinary Attacks. Spend rhythm on the right release, cash it out early for cover or deliberately restart it.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Latest fifth-pass concept explicitly signed off.

heroes.motionSignature: minimal breath-led bow motion; hood and chalk marks stay quiet until the visible finger release

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

bodyPoses.description: feet form the original ready silhouette; weapon points toward the current foe; shoulders breathe without changing face or scale. Hero handling: minimal breath-led bow motion; hood and chalk marks stay quiet until the visible finger release.

heroes.name: Gideon March

profile.identity: Gideon guarded caravans for thirty years without losing a passenger. The one empty carriage he brought home still follows him in his dreams.
profile.tradeoff: An elderly gatekeeper who prepares a Watch and chooses between contesting a visible charge, a penetrating strike and a safe release. He cannot predict the next enemy move.

conceptSource.owner_decision: Owner explicitly signed off all selected playable concepts without correction notes.

heroes.motionSignature: experienced caravan guard; shield remains close and lantern attachment survives every gate cut

socketDefinitions.weaponGrip: original concept weapon-hand wrist; fixed hilt/haft handle relative transform, no hand exchange
socketDefinitions.supportGrip: second actual wrist for two-handed gear, otherwise original offhand grip/strap
socketDefinitions.focusRelease: weapon focus head for spells; remains rigid to held weapon
socketDefinitions.projectileRelease: arrow nock/string line in bow release frame only
socketDefinitions.lantern: original concept belt/hip attachment, pendulum follows waist
socketDefinitions.tomeFolio: original supported offhand book or secured belt support, never floats
socketDefinitions.toolGrip: free wrists after combat equipment is visibly secured

gearContract.productionSocketCoordinates: Numerical wrist/focus/waist sockets must be measured from each future locked pose, recorded alongside pose IDs, and reviewed against its concept. No invented coordinates asserted from an unbuilt pose.
gearContract.twoHandRule: Two-handed weapons use both hands during contact. Preparation props remain supported/stowed; a free hand may gesture only with weapon butt grounded or weapon secured. Equipment compatibility remains the source proposal.
gearContract.continuity: No staff/sword/bow teleport, hand switch, disappearing shield, or midair tome. The same grip carries ready→windup→charge→release→recovery. Worn lantern remains present in every frame, including fallen and camp.
gearContract.cloth: strict pixel grid, one-pixel dark outline, flat shade clusters, intact costume; cloth lag follows torso with one reversal then settles. Preserve source head, face, scale, palette and original left/right attachments.

heroes.gatheringContract: All four actions run at every eligible live node without any tool. Crafted Pickaxe/Woodaxe/Sickle/Hunting Spear improves speed only. Bare-hand mining prises loose stone, wood gathers loose branches, forage plucks, hunting reads tracks/collects hide; no unarmed combat or extra foe art. Combat axe/spear is not silently a gathering tool.

totals.historicalReconciliation: 238 was the earlier Pip per-hero animation-frame estimate, not a 34-hero total and not a distinct-pose count. This plan refines scope with all signatures/shared cards, gathering equipment and no-tool variants, core/social states and separate FX. Compare Pip’s own timeline/body/FX columns with that initial budget only after choosing which category the earlier frames covered; the categories cannot be added or treated as equivalent.
